items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: Son. His name was, he played the drum, bass drum. Son Mason.

ctx.x: French is hard for me. Yeah. That Petuan, was a musician called Petuan? Petuan? Petuan? He said there was some fella they called Son too, Son Mason or something. I couldn't get it. Either he was a Mason or his name was Mason. Or maybe Son, Son Mason, yeah.
Son. His name was, he played the drum, bass drum. Son Mason. His name was... I don't know how you spell Son. I probably think of his name.
